declarations.description:
Draws its source image, video, or canvas through the pixel effects
wrapped around it.
declarations.name: PixelCanvas

cssParts.description: With `html`, where supported: the `<canvas layoutsubtree>` its content is laid out in and the result is drawn on. Invoker commands: `--play`, `--pause`, `--toggle`.
cssParts.name: html-canvas

members.name: #observer
members.default: new MutationObserver((records) => { if (records.some((record) => record.target !== this || record.type === "childList")) this.#schedule(); })

members.name: time
members.description:
Seconds on the clock that effects animate by. It runs while the
element is connected and not paused (and, for visitors who prefer
reduced motion, only once `play()` is called).

members.name: paused
members.description: Whether the clock is paused.

members.name: play
members.description: Start or resume the clock (and the `fps` redraws).

members.name: pause
members.description: Pause the clock where it is.

members.name: source
members.description: What's being drawn: the first element inside that's an ``, `

members.name: effectElements
members.description:
The effect elements wrapped around the source, in the order they run
(innermost first). Disabled ones are included.

members.name: effects
members.description: Mirrors the `effects` attribute.

members.name: swatches
members.description: How many swatches to publish. Mirrors the `swatches` attribute.

members.name: swatchesTarget
members.description: Mirrors the `swatches-target` attribute.

members.name: palette
members.description:
With `swatches`: the result's most common colors, as `#rrggbb`, most
common first. Empty otherwise.

members.name: canvas
members.description: The canvas showing the result (in the shadow root).

members.name: gpu
members.description: Mirrors the `gpu` attribute.

members.name: html
members.description: Mirrors the `html` attribute.

members.name: transition
members.description: Mirrors the `transition` attribute.

members.name: renderer
members.description: Where the last redraw ran: `"gpu"`, `"cpu"`, or `""` before the first.

members.name: captureStream
members.description: A video stream of the result, like `HTMLCanvasElement.captureStream()`.

members.name: record

type.text: { duration?: number, fps?: number, type?: string }

members.description:
Record the result as a video (WebM where supported, else MP4), for
`duration` seconds. Effects that change over time need `fps` (or a
playing video) to animate while it records.

members.name: toGIF

type.text: { duration?: number, fps?: number, frames?: number, loop?: number }

members.description:
The result as an animated GIF, at the working size: `frames` frames
(or `duration` seconds' worth) sampled `fps` times a second. Effects
that change over time need `fps` (or a playing video) to animate while
it captures. `loop`: 0 repeats forever, -1 plays once.

members.name: toText

type.text: { cell?: string, chars?: string, font?: string, mode?: string, background?: string }

members.description:
The result as text: with a `glyphs()` effect (or `<pixel-glyphs>`) in
the chain, the characters it chose, one line per row; otherwise the
result converted with `options` (the same as `glyphs()`'s parameters:
`cell`, `chars`, `font`, `mode`, `background`). It waits for a redraw,
which runs on the CPU, where the characters are known. Resolves to ""
if there's nothing to draw.

members.name: render
members.description: Draw now, instead of on the next frame. Returns whether it drew.

members.name: toBlob
members.description: The result as an image file, like `HTMLCanvasElement.toBlob()`.

members.name: toDataURL
members.description: The result as a data: URL, like `HTMLCanvasElement.toDataURL()`.

events.name: load
events.description: The first frame of a source was drawn.

events.name: framechange
events.description: After each redraw, so a `<pixel-canvas>` can be another one's source.

events.name: error
events.description: The source can't be read (for example, a cross-origin image without CORS) or an effect threw: an `ErrorEvent`, and the original content is shown instead. Also fired, once per name, for an unknown effect in `effects`, which is skipped.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Working width in pixels: the source is scaled to it (keeping its aspect ratio) before the effects run. Smaller is faster and chunkier. Default: the source's own width.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Working height, if `width` isn't given.

attributes.name: effects
attributes.description: Effects to apply, in order, like CSS `filter`: `mosaic(4) palette(gameboy, ordered) adjust(contrast 1.3)`. They run after any effect elements inside.

attributes.name: swatches
attributes.description: Publish the result's N most common colors as `--pixel-swatch-1` … `--pixel-swatch-N` custom properties (and the `palette` property). Default: none.

attributes.name: swatches-target
attributes.description: A selector for more elements to set those custom properties on (for example `html`, to theme the page). They're always set on the `<pixel-canvas>` itself.

attributes.name: fps
attributes.description: Redraw at this rate, so effects that change over time (`glitch`, `wave`, your own) animate even on a still image. Without it, it redraws only when something changes (or every frame of a playing video).

attributes.name: paused
attributes.description: Stops the clock effects animate by, and the `fps` redraws. Reflects; write it in markup to start paused.

attributes.name: html
attributes.description: Experimental: draw its own HTML content (live, and still interactive) through the effects, where the browser supports HTML-in-canvas; elsewhere the content shows as it is. Without `width`/`height`, one working pixel is one CSS pixel.

attributes.name: gpu
attributes.description: Run the effects on the GPU (WebGL2) when every effect in the chain can: the source is uploaded once and nothing is read back (unless `swatches` needs it). Otherwise, or without WebGL2, they run on the CPU as usual. `renderer` says which ran.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: Animate changes to `effects` over this long (`400ms`, `0.5s`): numbers in the same effects are interpolated; a different list of effects cross-fades. Not for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

declarations.description: Turns the image into text characters: each cell becomes the character that best matches it, from a font atlas measured from the real font. The element form of `glyphs(cell, chars, font, mode, color, background)`.

attributes.description: Cell size in working pixels, `8x12` (the default) or `10` for square. 2–32 a side.

attributes.name: color

attributes.description: Pass the image through unchanged.
